-- Subscriptions whose paid period has ended become 'expired'.
UPDATE subscriptions
   SET status = 'expired'
 WHERE status IN ('trialing', 'active', 'past_due')
   AND current_period_end IS NOT NULL
   AND current_period_end < now()
RETURNING id, user_id, plan;

-- Usage counters older than 90 days are of no further use.
DELETE FROM usage_counters WHERE period_start < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days';

-- Partner-analysis invitations time out.
UPDATE partner_analysis_links
   SET status = 'expired'
 WHERE status = 'pending' AND expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at < now();

-- Notifications that failed too many times stop being retried.
UPDATE notifications
   SET status = 'failed'
 WHERE status = 'sending' AND attempts >= 5;

SELECT
    (SELECT count(*) FROM users)                                AS users,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM agent_links WHERE status = 'active')  AS agents,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM crisis_events WHERE handled = false)  AS open_crisis;
